queue.scope: Piecewise-constant observed scheduler states. State-change/50ms snapshots are host observations,not GPU occupancy.

roles.scope: Intervals are clipped to the actual20second collector ROI. Inactivity is not physical GPU idle. Copies are NOT_MEASURED when disabled. Nested host API intervals are unioned,not summed. API overlap is not proof of causality. Quiescence ends at an observed receipt,not a known future arrival. No partition state was ready in this Native trace. No safe-fit or dynamic speedup follows from a gap length.
